title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Demurrage Day Rates for Special Equipment
content:
For demurrage days billed at special-class rates, the Demurrage and Detention Free Time products apply these daily figures, in US dollars for each container:

- **Every product except the contract product**: slab 1 at 120.00, slab 2 at 190.00, slab 3 at 275.00, slab 4 at 370.00.
- **AHL Contract Free Time 30**: slab 1 at 96.00, slab 2 at 152.00, slab 3 at 220.00, slab 4 at 296.00.

## Same figures by product

| Product | S1 | S2 | S3 | S4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 120.00 | 190.00 | 275.00 | 370.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 120.00 | 190.00 | 275.00 | 370.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 120.00 | 190.00 | 275.00 | 370.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 120.00 | 190.00 | 275.00 | 370.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 120.00 | 190.00 | 275.00 | 370.00 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 96.00 | 152.00 | 220.00 | 296.00 |

Hypothetical illustration: one special-class demurrage day in each of slabs 1 and 3 under AHL Tariff Free Time totals 120.00 and 275.00, that is 395.00.
